submitted.rationale: Index 8 (Pb0.52Sb0.48) is close to the Pb2Sb2O7 (1:1) pyrochlore-type phase in XRD, with no PbSb2O6 (001) peak at Q≈1.18. It had the highest measured EQE (0.0084%). The Pb-rich (idx 2) and Sb-rich (idx 12) measurements were lower.

rejected.reason: EQE -0.0023%. The Pb-rich phase is photoinactive.
EQE 0.00075%. Moving toward the wide-gap PbSb2O6 phase seen at idx 15/23 lowers EQE.
XRD shows the PbSb2O6 phase is dominant there, and it probably has a wide band gap. The EQE trend from idx 8 to idx 12 points downward.
